data.name: Garage door cause

description: HA-08 (operator request 2026-10-05). Writes every change of the garage door, including attribute-only obstruction flips, to the logbook with its likely cause, read from the state shape: Meross commands pass through opening/closing; anything else jumps directly between open and closed; opening->closed or closing->open is a timed-out Meross command. Logbook only: no notification, never moves the door.
